instruction: Work with command-line or batch-capable tools from Altium Designer, OrCAD Capture, or OpenSCAD. The neutral hierarchical full-adder design `fulladd` is on the desktop. Export its schematic hierarchy to `hierarchy.json`. Requirements: - `hierarchy.json` must contain root schematic name and a `schematics` dictionary. - Each schematic entry must include page count, total primitive parts, and referenced hierarchy blocks. - Repeated hierarchy-block references must be preserved. [Software] The available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`. Save the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`.
